rule_context: up to four whole paragraphs, <=5000 characters, selected by source column terms
apply_policy: Preserve existing canonical mappings; normalize role placement then require source evidence and full-column type checks; preserve unmapped status values with quality notes
note: Reference config matching CLI defaults; not an additional model or a fine-tuned checkpoint.
role_policy: Rule-based canonical first; SLM compares README meaning to canonical aliases/definitions before creating new semantic roles; canonical names misplaced in semantic_role are promoted and validated
related_context: same-business inventory plus up to 3 tables with 6000-character detail budget; reduce optional context if token budget requires

refinement.trigger: useful source-grounded meaning with missing or generic role
refinement.fallback: keep original result if refinement fails
